name: io.github.agentsearchhq-coder/agentsearch-mcp
title: AgentSearch (agentsearchhq.com)
description: Free web search + extract/render free trial (no key), then $0.005/call via x402 on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet with a little USDC on Base; enables paid extract/render ($0.005 per call) via the Pocket portal (x402). Without it, extract/render use the free trial (5/3 calls per day per IP). Search stays free unless AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid. Alias: POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Search mode: free (default; free relay even with a wallet key), paid (pay $0.005 per search; needs a key) or auto (paid search when a key is set)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to turn off the no-wallet extract/render free trial (then no-wallet extract/render make no network call). Default on

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Session spend cap in USDC atomic units (default 1000000 = $1.00). Alias: POCKET_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MAX_PER_CALL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Optional lower per-call cap (max and default 5000 = $0.005)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted AgentSearch API base URL; when set, search/extract/render use it with no payment

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer token for your AgentSearch API

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Review Board key for weighted reviews
